protocol.training: Exact shipped provider histories: two clans, random limit 60, CWL limit 35. Every replay uses the shipped 14-day normal window, latest two available eligible CWL editions, exact modifier and pre-war cutoff.
protocol.scope: Latest observed completed season shared by selected seeds. Missing rounds remain missing. No application DB writes.
protocol.observed: Only actual attacked pairs have realized outcomes. Optimized and mirror totals are model expectations, never claimed realized gains.
protocol.baseline: Weighted training-only global star distribution with +1 pseudocount; contextual baseline uses CWL, same defender CV, clamped CV delta and phase, shrunk with prior mass 10.
protocol.goals: Evaluate pre-war goals on actual fresh pairs; target choice is observed after the fact, not an official historic mission. No retroactive merit ranking.
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 deterministic unique-war block draws; both sides of the same war stay together. Dependence across wars within a clan/edition remains a limitation. No parameter selected from this test set.
